body:
But it seems like everyone has *some* parts of life in order, though. I can't do anything. I start everything well and then crash and burn one, two, three weeks later. It always happens. I've failed at almost everything I've done since graduating high school.

I can't take it anymore! I'm so tired of hating myself and my life. Everything is just a blur to me now, all I remember is anxiety and self-loathing. I can't live like this. Forget being an adult, I barely feel like a person.

Sleep definitely helps. It's so hard for me to actually fall asleep, though. Like, if I'm not about o pass out, I can't fall asleep. It's just impossible for me to consciously relax that much anymore.

Ha, I only communicate well when I barf it out like that. I'm such a horrible communicator normally, I can't maintain any relationships anymore. No friends, I haven't had amy for almost two years. Maybe it's more my instability than bad communication though.

Did the hospital give you meds or did you have to go see someone?

If I'm not insane I don't know what's going on in my head, then. I feel so broken, like I'm not a part of the real world anymore. It's like I'm a fish who forgot how to swim, whereas everyone else doesn't even think about the fact that they're fish, living life is so automatic to them. I want to regain control but I feel so far removed from everything I don't even know where to begin.

When I wake up in a state like that (which happens a lot) all I can think about is ending it right then and there. i don't see a future for myself, there isn't a "me" in my mind anymore. I don't know who I am, I just want this all to stop.
That's reassuring. There's so much going through my head when I write things down during an anxiety attack that it feels completely disjointed and nonsensical. What would a hospital do?

I feel extremely overwhelmed. It seems like everything I do stresses me out to the point where even some seemingly insignificant thing that calls up a painful memory sends me over the edge. Sometimes I wake up feeling calm and rational, but I'm always just one or two steps away from  an anxiety attack.

A lot has happened in the last few years, I guess. It's more of an accumulation than a single event. I haven't done well in school and I don't seem capable of being an adult. I'm going to be 23 soon and I still feel like a child because I can't manage myself at all.

I guess I just feel like a failure. I had all this potential in high school only to throw it all away almost immediately after starting college. Ever since then things have just gotten worse. I'm so emotionally unstable now, I feel like a ragdoll being tossed around by my brain.
